messages:
claire: heads-up - saw an 8-12% p95 latency bump on host decode path after the kernel-selector rollout to canary. Spikes line up with lots of small streaming reqs (~<200 tokens).

sam: yup saw it too. can you paste flamegraph or perf snapshot?

bench-bot: perf report uploaded: https://perf/reports/7965432100 — p95 +11% vs baseline. Top stacks: host::parse_line, tokenizer::utf8_normalize, http2::writev_smallwrites.

sam: quick pprof top snippet:
```
45.2% host::parse_line
18.7% tokenizer::utf8_normalize
12.3% http2::writev_smallwrites
```
My guess: kernel selector change increased chunking, resulting in smaller host-side batches and more small writes.

ajay: do we see KV cache missrate change? kernel switch could change seqlen distribution and break prefetch heuristics.

marta: KV missrate up ~3% on canary, evictions spike in 90s windows. Seems mini-batches are smaller -> higher unique prefix churn.

claire: hypothesis: new kernel selection lowered batch assembly window and caused more host framing/syscall overhead + extra KV churn.

sam: quick experiment plan: raise batch_assembly_ms from 5 -> 12 on the canary and rebench. apply override: 
```
curl -X POST https://canary/api/override -d '{"batch_assembly_ms":12}'
```

bench-bot: re-run finished — p95 reduced ~6% toward baseline, cost +1.7%. Flamegraph shows far fewer http2 writev_smallwrites. link: https://perf/reports/7965432100/retry1

ajay: sounds like a reasonable trade. Another idea: coalesce small writes in the host proxy (io.coalesce=true) — might give similar p95 without hurting batching semantics.

marta: also seeing tokenizer hotspot in utf8_normalize. For ascii-heavy traffic we can switch to a vectorized path that avoids per-codepoint checks. I have microbench showing ~20% cycles saved for common inputs.

sam: can we A/B both changes? i.e. batch window bump + io.coalesce + tokenizer vectorized path + kv prefetch tweak, but staged. Need to watch memory for KV shadowing.

claire: rollout proposal (staged):
- stage1: batch_assembly_ms=12 on 10% canary (monitor p50/p95, kv_miss, cost)
- stage2: enable host-proxy io.coalesce on same 10% canary
- stage3: tokenizer vectorized path + kv prefetch tuning on canary
- rollback if p95 > baseline + 10% or kv_miss > baseline + 5%
Assign: sam -> implement the runtime overrides and dashboards, ajay -> kv prefetch tuning and safety limits, marta -> tokenizer patch and microbench. I'll coordinate the rollout and watch alerts. Any objections? :eyes:

ajay: no objections, starting kv prefetch PR now. :thumbsup:

marta: starting tokenizer PR, will include bench artifacts and a small unit test for ascii fastpath.

sam: implementing the override + adding a short-term trace sampler to capture http2 write patterns. will post updated perf links here. thanks all.
